title: Packers RB Josh Jacobs to be removed from NFL's commissioner exempt list, will be eligible to play Week 7

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Packers RB Josh Jacobs to be removed from NFL's commissioner exempt list, will be eligible to play Week 7
sources.description: Jacobs was arrested for domestic abuse last May and was placed on the list ahead of the season. The league says the investigation into Jacobs' conduct is still ongoing.
